source_text: Infibulation causes immediate risks including hemorrhage, infection, and shock, as well as long-term complications such as chronic pain, urinary and menstrual difficulties, obstetric fistula, infertility, and increased maternal and neonatal mortality during childbirth; psychological effects include depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress disorder, substantiated by epidemiological studies across affected regions.
